chapter: Sideman years: J.J., Tyree Glenn, Sweets
title: Playing with Tyree Glenn at the Roundtable
summary: Before J.J. he worked about a year with Tyree Glenn's trombone-and-vibes group at the Roundtable.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: you also worked with J. J. Johnson?
Yes before I worked with J.J. I worked with Tyree Glen ad the round table on 52nd street and Lexington, The Embers was around the corner, all of these clubs. That was educational for me cause-­
Yeah trombone and vibes cause the first night I started Hank was playing the piano and the next night somebody else was there! And he’s playing all these tunes and I said
“I’ll just play with Tyree I don’t know what these guys are doing” Then Tommy Flanagan and it started to get a little tighter and Tommy Potter was playing bass.
And how long did that engagement last?
